note: Added 2026-09-09 together with 13 sibling Greater Vancouver property tax notices, on request, to grow `propertytax` coverage from 6 documents to 20. The ONLY notice in the corpus issued by the PROVINCE rather than a municipality: 'BRITISH COLUMBIA | Ministry of Finance', a 2026 Rural Property Tax Notice under the Taxation (Rural Area) Act. vendor_name is therefore 'Ministry of Finance' and not a City/District name -- this is the counter-example that stops any future rule assuming a propertytax notice is issued by a municipality. total_invoice_amount is the COLUMN A (no home owner grant) figure -- the amount payable when no grant is claimed, which is the column the pipeline chose on all 14 new notices. A=3,138.43 / B=2,568.43 / C=2,293.43, verified against the remittance stub ('A - Pay this amount if you are not applying for the home owner grant 3,138.43'). account_number from the printed 'Account Number: RPT-1088-2731'. invoice_date IS asserted: the page prints 'May 12, 2026' beside the Letter Id, so 2026-05-12 is a read value and not the today() default. payment_due_date from 'DUE DATE: July 2, 2026'. || invoice_description NOT asserted: free-text that rewords itself every run. || The narrative fields (diagnosis_solution, recommendation, warranty and their zh_hant twins) are blank by policy on a municipal bill. || folio_number ADDED 2026-09-09 with the new folio twins (commercial-narrative-v20). It is a critical field on property tax notices only (field_policy.PROPERTYTAX_DELTA), and is asserted on every sidecar -- the value on a tax notice, "" everywhere else -- so a regression that starts populating it on ordinary invoices is caught. || account_number RE-BASELINED 2026-09-09 to the FOLIO (user decision): when a property tax notice prints BOTH a folio number and an account number, the folio is the one kept. This notice is one of only two in the corpus where the two genuinely differ -- on the other 18 the fields already held the same string. The displaced value was 'Account No: RPT-1088-2731', recorded here so the change is reversible. Scoped to municipal + propertytax in field_policy.propertytax_account_from_folio. NOTE the displaced value is the one this notice prints under its OWN account label; on property_north_van_district that is the number the stub gives for ONLINE BANKING. See DV-11 before anything downstream pays or reconciles from this column. || billing_period_start_date AND billing_period_end_date ASSERTIONS REMOVED 2026-09-09 (user authorised, all 20 propertytax sidecars): the Power Automate flow does not consume the billing period for property tax, so the corpus no longer asserts it on this family. Both fields REMAIN in WRITE_FIELDS and still reach Dynamics -- removing the assertion stops the corpus checking them, it does not stop them being written. What this gives up, stated once: on the 16 notices that asserted '' the pair was the guard against a generate twin inventing a period out of nothing, and on property_surrey it was catching a real failure chain -- B3's invented number_of_days=1 makes the code derive start = end - 1 day, which collapses the period to zero length and blanks a correct 2026-01-01 (open-defects A13b, measured 4 of 6 reads correct). That chain is unfixed and is now invisible to the corpus on every property tax notice.
